List discovered KB provider packages

Source: R/mcp_kb_tools.R
list_certara_kb_packages.Rd

List discovered KB provider packages

Usage

list_certara_kb_packages()

Value

A list with packages (loaded providers) and skipped (incompatible/invalid manifests with reasons).

Examples

list_certara_kb_packages()
#> $packages
#> $packages[[1]]
#> $packages[[1]]$package
#> [1] "Certara.R"
#> 
#> $packages[[1]]$package_version
#> [1] "2.0.0"
#> 
#> $packages[[1]]$schema_version

#> $packages[[1]]$entry_count
#> [1] 2
#> 
#> $packages[[1]]$engine
#> NULL
